title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save 47% on the Roborock Qrevo CurvX robot vacuum and mop
excerpt: A full-featured robot vacuum and mop that can make short work of your cleaning schedule.
content_html:
SAVE $700: As of July 29, get the Roborock Qrevo CurvX robot vacuum and mop for $799.99 at Amazon. That's a discount of 47%.

No matter what your regular cleaning routine looks like, a robot vacuum can definitely make it easier for you. And if you want one to completely cut all the effort you have to put into this regular ritual, you'll want to take a look at the model that's on sale at Amazon right now. Not only does it look futuristic, but it behaves that way, too.

As of July 29, get the Roborock Qrevo CurvX robot vacuum and mop for $799.99 at Amazon. That's $700 off and a discount of 47%.

Mashable Trend Report

This powerful robot vacuum boasts 22,000Pa of suction with a zero-tangling design to make sure it can continuously cut through even tough messes with ease. It's the slimmest Roborock vacuum in the lineup according to the company, so it can reach those difficult areas and get to all the problem cleaning spots that you can't normally vacuum. And that's just the start of its set of abilities.

This robot vacuum is also a mop, and it uses 80-degree hot water to both work through grease and other stubborn stains. The mop heads are cleaned between uses, so things stay sanitary while you're tidying up. It also uses a special AdaptiLift Chassis to lift the robot's entire body to reach specific areas, whether vacuuming or mopping, to tackle the more difficult problem spaces in your home.

If you've been looking for a great option to scrub down your home (without your input, unless you want to provide it) this is an excellent robot vacuum that can only improve your routines. Grab it while it's available for such a deep discount.

可混搭趋势报告

这款功能强大的扫地机器人拥有 22,000Pa 的吸力和零缠结设计，确保它能够轻松地连续清除棘手的杂物。 据该公司称，这是该系列中最薄的 Roborock 真空吸尘器，因此它可以到达那些困难的区域，并到达您通常无法吸尘的所有有问题的清洁点。 这只是其一系列能力的开始。

这款机器人真空吸尘器也是拖把，它使用 80 度的热水来清除油脂和其他顽固污渍。 拖把头在使用之间会进行清洁，因此在您整理时可以保持卫生。 它还使用特殊的 AdaptiLift 底盘来提升机器人的整个身体以到达特定区域，无论是吸尘还是拖地，以解决家中更困难的问题空间。
